facts.business: TCPL Packaging Limited is an integrated packaging company manufacturing paperboard packaging (folding cartons, printed blanks, outers, litho-laminated cartons) and flexible packaging (printed laminates, pouches, wrap-around labels, shrink sleeves), along with rigid boxes, gravure printing cylinders, and recyclable films, serving FMCG, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, tobacco, e-commerce, consumer durables, and electronics.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Commitment to achieve carbon neutrality for Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions
